name: fablecut
description: Zero-dependency browser video editor that AI agents can drive — JSON timeline, MCP tools, live-reloading UI.
long_description: FableCut is a Premiere-style non-linear video editor that runs in the browser with zero npm dependencies. An AI agent edits video by patching a single project.json timeline (clips, keyframes, transitions, text animations, filters, speed ramps, adjustment layers) through MCP tools; the open editor UI live-reloads within ~150 ms and exports MP4 via ffmpeg. Includes reference-video analysis (shot cuts, beats, BPM, energy, drop) so agents can remake an edit with new footage.

tools.name: fablecut_status
tools.description: Auto-start the editor server and return its URL plus a project summary

tools.name: fablecut_docs
tools.description: Return the full editor manual (project.json schema, props, recipes), optionally a single section

tools.name: fablecut_get_project
tools.description: Read the timeline JSON (compact mode available for token-efficient planning)

tools.name: fablecut_set_project
tools.description: Replace the timeline JSON with optimistic-concurrency conflict detection

tools.name: fablecut_patch_project
tools.description: Apply targeted, merge-safe ops (add/update/remove clip or media, set project fields, track levels, submix buses, audio effects and their automation, color grades and secondaries) and timeline edits (split, ripple delete, lift/extract, insert/overwrite, ripple/roll/slip/slide, crossfade)

tools.name: fablecut_import_media
tools.description: Copy a local file into the project's media folder and register it

tools.name: fablecut_analyze_reference
tools.description: Analyze a reference video into an edit blueprint: shot cuts, beats, BPM, energy curve, drop; extracts its music

tools.name: fablecut_frame
tools.description: Look at the footage: one JPEG frame of a source clip at a timestamp, an N-up contact sheet across a clip, or the composed timeline rendered and graded at a moment - returned inline as an image the agent can see

tools.name: fablecut_encode_profiles
tools.description: List the ffmpeg encoding profiles available for Fast export

tools.name: fablecut_normalize_audio
tools.description: Loudness-normalize clips (BS.1770 LUFS or sample peak) by setting their clip gain

tools.name: fablecut_auto_duck
tools.description: Duck music under dialogue: write duck keyframes wherever the voice tracks speak

tools.name: fablecut_denoise
tools.description: Reduce background noise on audio clips: render a cleaned copy of the file and switch the clips to it

tools.name: fablecut_export
tools.description: Render the timeline to a video file with the editor's Fast export, in an open editor tab or a headless browser

tools.name: fablecut_scopes
tools.description: Measure the graded picture at a moment: luma levels, clipping, mean RGB, saturation and colour cast — and what a grade layer's matte selects
